reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped six-domain source review of the source-scientific numerical contract, full input and return scientific schema, exceptional domains and inferential interpretation. Direct frozen Python 1.2 source-typed differential tests are committed but exact-head runner results and independent certification are not yet available.
native_language_semantic_policy: Source scientific data and estimand represented by native R checked lists/data.frames/matrices, not Python frozen dataclass or pandas runtime identity. In bootstrap width comparison shared source fit is established by native R structural fitted-record equality, not Python object pointer identity.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python typed generalized FoSR result, fixed profile DataFrame and optional target exposure and prediction-scale inputs; native R validated scientific fit and data.frame analogue.

Finite observed-grid basis and GEE robust covariance with two scalar predictor columns, distinct fixed profile names, binomial and Poisson families, unexposed counts, exposed rates and explicit target-exposure counts.

Complete source expanded scalar-by-basis design and robust quadratic covariance prediction, inverse logit/Poisson response and marginal delta SE, exposure offsets, exact predictor minima/maxima and extrapolation flags.
Missing/duplicated profile IDs or columns, invalid predictor numbers, malformed basis/coefficient/covariance arrays, forbidden scale, absent or invalid exposure and source overflow fail closed.

All source profile IDs, design/predictor arrays, linear and mean response predictions/SE, exposure/rate/count optional fields and full source metadata/provenance; Python frozen dataclass is a native R scientific list.

Fixed predeclared analyst target marginal/population-averaged response predictions on the observed grid with robust GEE parameter covariance; no automatic target selection or simultaneous inferential coverage.

independent_review_status: Provisional author-reviewed only; exact-head CI and independent certification pending.
language_specific_limits: Python frozen dataclass and pandas class identity and Python exception class identities are not native R contracts.
R shared-source reference checks compare complete reference fit scientific content; Python's same-object pointer identity has no direct requirement in R scientific list APIs.
No downstream native upstream model fitting or CRAN qualification is certified by these postfit scientific function comparisons.
